thread:
Diego: Double good news — Sofia and I closed on our first house this morning 🏡🎉 Also, Nora just accepted the Senior PM role! Cake in the kitchen at 4 to celebrate both. Come by if you can. :tada:
Nora: WHAT!! 😭😭😭 thank you everyone. can’t wait to celebrate. huge thanks to the whole product + eng crew for the support 🙏
Carlos: omg congrats Diego & Nora!! I’ll bring coffee and croissants for the 4pm rally ☕🥐
Mei: hell yes congrats!!! moving favor: if you need a weekend crew for lifting furniture i’m free. also what’s the new neighborhood?
Diego: thanks! we’re in Dogwood Heights (near the park). moving will be next Saturday, help gratefully accepted — i’ll DM details.
Anika: congrats Nora!! SO WELL DESERVED. do you want a tiny banner or a sash for the cake ceremony? :partyparrot:
Nora: sash pls. and maybe a tiny crown 👑
Jordan: cake ordering note: the kitchen fridge is small. can someone pick a cake that fits into the office fridge or we stage it on the bench? or we do cupcakes instead.
Priya: i’ll put in a quick chat to ops to reserve the kitchen table at 3:45 and snag plates/napkins. also recorded congrats from People Ops Bot coming through ✨
People Ops Bot: Congrats to Nora on promotion to Senior PM! Automated message: please check your updated org profile and enjoy the celebratory cake at 4pm. :confetti_ball:
Carlos: also time to plan a housewarming potluck — Diego, do you have a registry or a fav local pizza place?
Diego: no registry, thanks for asking. favorite pizza is Tony’s on 8th. potluck sounds perfect. i’ll post a sign-up tomorrow. thanks everyone for the love ❤️
Mei: bringing shelving tools and a cordless drill for moving day (just saying).
Anika: can we get a group photo at 4? new tradition?
Nora: yes please. and i’ll try not to cry on camera.
Jordan: count me in — congrats again both of you!!! :raised_hands:
Priya: logged a calendar invite for 4pm cake + 4:15 quick shoutout — all welcome.
Diego: truly grateful. see you all this afternoon :)
